question: Who among the following launched the Nationwide Mass Drug Administration Campaign for Lymphatic Filariasis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jagat Prakash Nadda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nationwide Mass Drug Administration (MDA) Campaign** for Lymphatic Filariasis (LF) was launched by **Jagat Prakash Nadda**, the then Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare in India.
 
• The campaign is a part of India's commitment to eliminate **Lymphatic Filariasis (LF)** as a public health problem, in line with the global goal of eradicating the disease by **2030**.
 
• The **Mass Drug Administration** involves the distribution of preventive medications, such as **Diethylcarbamazine Citrate (DEC) and Albendazole**, to the population at risk of the disease.
 
• The program aims to interrupt the transmission of the filarial parasite by ensuring the intake of these drugs by the majority of the population in endemic areas.
 
• India has the highest burden of Lymphatic Filariasis globally, with over **650 million people** at risk of infection in endemic districts across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lymphatic Filariasis:**

 
 
• **Lymphatic Filariasis**, commonly known as elephantiasis, is a neglected tropical disease caused by infection with parasitic worms transmitted through the bites of infected mosquitoes.
 
• The disease causes severe swelling in the arms, legs, breasts, and genitalia, leading to disability and social stigma.
 
• Three species of worms are primarily responsible: **Wuchereria bancrofti, Brugia malayi, and Brugia timori**.
 
• Lymphatic Filariasis is endemic in more than **70 countries**, with a significant burden in tropical and subtropical regions.
 
 
 
• **India's Efforts to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis:**
 
 
• India is committed to eliminating **Lymphatic Filariasis** by 2030, in alignment with the WHO's Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis (GPELF).
 
• The **National Filaria Control Programme (NFCP)** was launched in **1955** to combat the disease in endemic areas through vector control and treatment.
 
• The **Mass Drug Administration (MDA)** campaign is one of the most significant steps taken by the government to combat LF by providing preventive drugs to large populations.
 
 
 
• **Jagat Prakash Nadda:**
 
 
• **Jagat Prakash Nadda** is an Indian politician and the current National President of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** since January 2020.
 
• He has served as the **Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare** in the Government of India from 2014 to 2019.
 
• During his tenure as Health Minister, he spearheaded several health initiatives, including the **Nationwide Mass Drug Administration Campaign** for Lymphatic Filariasis and the implementation of the **Ayushman Bharat Yojana**.
 
 
 
• **Global Programme to Eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis (GPELF):**
 
 
• The World Health Organization (WHO) launched this program in **2000** to eliminate Lymphatic Filariasis as a public health problem worldwide by **2030**.
 
• The two main strategies of GPELF are **interrupting transmission** through MDA and **managing morbidity and preventing disability** in affected individuals.
 
• It is estimated that around **36 million people** currently suffer from the disfiguring and debilitating effects of LF globally.
